properties.name: Delivery arithmetic counts work that is not code, so a design whose product is a model is not reported as undelivered
properties.statement:
What counts as delivering a capability must be stateable. Where delivery is assumed to mean an artifact on disk, every design whose output is a model, a document or a decision reports as undelivered forever and the number stops meaning anything.

THE NEED, from the measured defect rather than the remedy: an epoch reported delivery against capabilities whose product was never going to be a file, so the figure could only ever fall. Found by running the loop honestly rather than by looking for it, 2026-08-20.

It can fail independently: any future delivery computation that keys on artifacts alone breaks it.
